guardrail: The stream computes the answer instead of the model learning it. code_cmds maintains loc[path]->content_id and on 'mv A B' performs loc[dst]=resolve(src), simulating the move chain symbolically in Python, then stamps a hash of the resolved identity into the command token. At the scored read the stamp IS the routed content. Verified: the read command string is byte-identical in both arms yet its stamped code differs by 3.44, so the differential cannot cancel it (native_wm 0.944, swap_follow 0.899, swap_stayed 0.045, uniform across shortcut strata). Causally legal and it passed every gate, but comp_ca is meant to measure whether the trained world model carries content across hops, and a symbolic mv-simulator in the data pipeline is the answer key rather than a world model. Retracted for reachability of the objective outside the model, not for a defect in the code.
